verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships `edge0 serve`, which exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint on localhost (shown with a curl example), so a coding agent that accepts an OpenAI-style base URL could plausibly use it as its model backend. Nothing shows this actually works for agentic coding, since tool/function calling, streaming and agent setup are not documented. Missing for 10: evidence of tool/function-calling support in the server, documented setup with specific coding agents, streaming/endpoint compatibility details, and independent or hands-on reports of an agent running against it.
